text_block_list.text:
After going out with Taiki Shuttle, while 
taking a breather in the Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Trainer-san, let's head home 
together~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The outing isn't over until we're back at 
the dorm! Please keep the fun chat going~!
choice_data_list: Sorry, I've got work right after this...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Nothing to be done about it then, 
butâ

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Si! I will wait right here for Trainer, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, please work until your heart's 
content-o!
choice_data_list:
It'll take until night—are you sure you're 
okay with that?

It'll take until night—are you sure you're 
okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! I'll be quiet so I don't get 
in your way!

—By the time my work was done, night had 
fully set in.
choice_data_list: All done. Sorry to keep you waiting.
All done! Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: *Deep breathing*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Ha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san! I stayed really 
quiet, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san! I stayed really 
quiet, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non-non, that's not true at all! I saw you 
working hard, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I did fall asleep for just a bit, 
though~! HAHAHA!"
choice_data_list: I'll walk you back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh!? Trainer! That's rude to do to a lady!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you walk home with me, I'll 
forgive you this time♪
choice_data_list: I'll walk you back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, yup! Thank you, my dear Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A reward is essential for someone working 
as hard as ME. If it's for this happiness, 
I can wait forever and ever♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll walk veeeery slowly, so let's chat a 
lot, okay?

On the way back, Taiki Shuttle happily 
chatted the whole time. Her face was 
positively glowing with happiness!
